text:
maya: Quick preflight - before we flip GA I want clear owners for a few last-mile items: SLA exceptions matrix, private-deploy playbook, billing-dispute routing, monitoring SLO examples, and customer FAQ. can we assign?

eli: I'll own the SLA exceptions matrix. plan: table mapping model_family | max_input_tokens | covered_by_SLA | fallback_policy. will post draft by Tue EOD.

sam: i can pair with eli to add an SLO / error-budget example. tiny snippet i'll include: 
```
error_budget = 1 - p99_target
monthly_budget_minutes = error_budget * minutes_in_month
```
will upload a worked example by Wed.

sophia: docs owner: private-deploy runbook + KMS snippet + audit-log queries. will also draft a short FAQ blurb about "what the SLA covers". ETA: Thu AM.

noah: ops: billing disputes -> billing-oncall (24h ack) -> product-policy (4h) -> legal for contract exceptions. i'll update rota and add a per-route cost-spike alert to the dashboard. ETA: Fri noon.

ops-bot: reminder: staging smoke test w/ SLO checks scheduled for 2025-11-04T09:00Z :robot_face: 

maya: Think about one more product nuance: hosted SLA should exclude long-context and non-verified models. eli/sam add that as a conditional clause in the draft.

eli: ack. we'll include wording like: "SLA applies only to Redwood-verified models with input length <= 1024 tokens; other cases are best-effort." will put in the draft.

sam: legal note: mark any promotional burst credits as "pilot credits" with 30-day revoke. legal needs to sign off on final phrasing.

sophia: i'll surface the SLA caveat as a banner in private-deploy docs + an example config showing token_limit enforcement.

maya: Acceptance gate for me: owners ack + artifacts merged in repo: SLA-exceptions.md, private_deploy_quickstart.md, ops_playbook.md, pricing_pilot_clause.txt. Reply with "ack + ETA". if all acked by EOD Fri we'll flip GA flag next week.

eli: ack Tue EOD (SLA draft).

sam: ack Wed EOD (SLO example + legal note).

sophia: ack Thu AM (docs PR).

noah: ack Fri noon (rota + dashboard).

maya: thanks. if anything slips, post blockers here. otherwise i'll schedule final ship-multicast after smoke passes. :rocket:
